title: Power BI Peak Concurrency Tracking
dataSources: Power BI admin refreshes (`powerbi:admin:refreshes`), admin API (`powerbi:admin:api`), gateway logs, and capacity metrics.
app: Power BI activity events from the Microsoft 365 / Purview audit log and the Power BI Admin & Fabric Capacity Metrics APIs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:admin:api
| bin _time span=5m
| stats dc(session_id) as concurrent by _time
| timechart span=1h max(concurrent) as peak_concurrency, avg(concurrent) as avg_concurrency
description: Measures concurrent Power BI sessions in five-minute buckets and rolls the peak up hourly, revealing the load peaks that drive sizing and licensing decisions.
value: Peak concurrency, not average, determines whether Power BI has enough capacity; tracking it prevents peak-hour slowdowns and right-sizes the platform.
implementation: Ingest Power BI session events; schedule hourly and alert when peak concurrency approaches the licensed or engineered limit.
visualization: Timechart of Power BI peak vs. average concurrency.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities / audit log

grandmaExplanation: We watch how many people use Power BI at the same time so it can be sized for the busy periods.
